input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Advance research programme sensing-selfcal (track 15 draw): milestone 4k, warm-start the TUM subset solves from the fleet spec focal length plus a basin check, pre-registered H68-H72

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py for this project's requirements took ~4 min on first use; the documented 20s-2min range understates it when opencv and scipy are both missing.

Experiment dirs all name their scripts run.py/analyse.py, so a new test that does `sys.path.insert; import run` silently picks up another milestone's module from sys.modules; load by path with importlib instead (test_m4k does).
Running all of tests/ while a 4-core solve job is in the background passed 10 min and had to be stopped; run only the milestone's own tests while experiments run.

deviations.why: Landing work step 2 asks to work through open research PRs before building; with ~100 open PRs repo-wide and a clear CLAIM CHECK for this programme, I went straight to the programme step.
deviations.result: No duplicate; claim check clear at start.

goal: research at PhD+ level (sensing, fleet camera recalibration)
notes: Pre-registration (LOG entry + run.py) committed and pushed before any solve. 11,442 warm-start solves ~85 min on 4 cores; analysis ~10 min. All five predictions refuted: the far subset solves are true minima (warm start reproduces all 38; on fr3 they fit as well as the 13-view solve), the spec start drops the Kinect 13-view solve into a worse minimum (rms 0.48 vs 0.15 px), and a ±10% basin check raises false alarms at k=4 to 20% on fr3. Checks run: tests/test_m4k.py + test_m4j.py 7 passed; paper/check_numbers.py 185/185; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; cite_check ok; post front matter, links and similarity ok. No agent doc in docs/reports: the LOG and README Next steps carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a research engineer designing, running (2 h compute) and writing up a pre-registered solver experiment with paper edits

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
